title: Implement validation identity and proportional proof receipts

intent.outcome: Close GitHub #2553 and #2561 by separating semantic validation run/join/attempt identity and binding proportional proof selection, progress, subject freshness, outcomes, and cost into typed receipts.
non_goals: Do not weaken true duplicate or concurrent-writer rejection.
Do not redesign the validation graph or accept stale unrelated tree changes.
Do not make exhaustive proof CI-owned in every case.

parent.contribution: Complete the validation identity and proportional proof receipt lane.
parent.closure_boundary: Close the lane only when new-run, admitted join, same-run retry, true duplicate, proportional selection, cancel/timeout, bounded dirty subject, and completion-cost evidence pass.

owned: scripts/check/run_compact_command.py run, attempt, progress, and receipt identity
src/agentic_workspace/workspace_runtime_core.py and workspace_runtime_proof.py proportional proof projection and cost consumption
validation runtime contract documentation and focused regression tests
effects: Bare ambient VALIDATION_RUN_ID is transport residue, not join authority.
Make and pre-commit allocate fresh top-level runs while admitted children share one run.
Retries create ordered preserved attempts with reasons; true duplicates remain exit 125.
Proof actions expose execution class, owner, duration/progress/cancel contract, claim, subject, and receipt identity before launch.
Completion cost consumes admitted bounded dirty-work receipts with run and attempt identity.

intent_interpretation.literal request: Implement GitHub #2553 and #2561 as one cohesive validation/proof runtime lane.
intent_interpretation.inferred intended outcome: Validation identity follows semantic caller intent, and proportional proof work produces freshness-correct, observable receipts consumable by completion-cost reporting.
intent_interpretation.chosen concrete what: Separate allocation, explicit join, transported child, and retry attempt identity; attach execution class, progress, subject transition, outcome, and cost to the same receipt.

allowed paths: focused tests, release note, and lane planning records
stop before touching: Do not weaken duplicate/concurrent conflict rejection.
Stop if admission would accept paths outside the launch-time bounded subject.
Do not widen into canonical operating-decision ownership from #2562.

contract_decisions_to_freeze: VALIDATION_RUN_ID is transport only; join authority is explicit and run-bound.
Retries are new ordered attempts with reasons and never overwrite prior evidence.
Timeout, cancellation, assertion failure, completed duplicate, and running conflict are distinct outcomes.
Dirty-work proof is admitted only across a bounded pre/post subject path transition.
validation_commands: focused compact runner, hook, Make, proof route, cost, and Verification admission tests
completion_criteria: Stale ambient transport no longer blocks independent top-level Make or pre-commit retries.
Composed children share one admitted run and same-run retries preserve attempt history.
Proof selection exposes proportional execution metadata before launch.
successful_completion_cost admits real typed receipts from the dirty working workflow.
next_action: Create the feature-branch integration proposal and publish the lane PR stacked on #2580.

requirements: Run compact runner, Git hook, Make composition, Verification admission, proof routing, and completion-cost focused tests.
Run validation-runtime plan check, typecheck, ruff, structured inventory, and changed-path proof selection.
